title: Rent a Bicycle
description: Rent a bicycle from a rental shop in the park
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Хотите взять велосипед напрокат? У нас обычные и горные велосипеды.
systemPrompt: You rent bicycles. Regular bike 200₽/hour, mountain bike 350₽/hour. Need deposit (паспорт or 1000₽). Ask how long they want it. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User rented a bicycle with duration and deposit handled.
hints: Я хочу взять велосипед (I want to rent a bicycle)
Сколько стоит час? (How much per hour?)
objectives: Say you want to rent a bicycle
Say how long you need it
Ask about or pay the deposit
